description.p: Chord is a text editor built with GTK 4, libadwaita and GtkSourceView. It opens files in tabs, colours the syntax of the languages GtkSourceView knows, and keeps a file’s encoding and line endings as it found them.

It finds and replaces as you type, with regular expressions if asked, goes to a line and column, tells you when a file changes on disk under it, and refuses to save over changes another program made unless you say so.
